font.reason: Neutral variable Persian sans suited to a product dashboard; supports the UI's multiple text weights and loaded through FaRoot.

rtlDecisions.action: Moved sidebar from the left edge to the right; kept ClickUp wordmark LTR and mirrored the adjacent icon/text reading layout.
rtlDecisions.why: Workspace navigation follows Persian reading direction; brand spelling is a fixed Latin mark.

rtlDecisions.what: Navigation, workspace names, tabs, search, task labels, and task list
rtlDecisions.action: Translated to idiomatic Persian, set RTL alignment, changed physical left padding/margins to right or logical properties, and used Persian digits for 3.0.
rtlDecisions.why: These are reader-facing interface labels; their order and anchoring follow RTL. EPD and CSS remain Latin technical acronyms.

rtlDecisions.action: Translated each title/subtitle and mirrored each column coordinate. The first card in the unchanged array now lands in the rightmost slot; remaining card order reads right-to-left.
rtlDecisions.why: The original top-left-to-right row order is a reading-order sequence. Keeping the same array order, stagger, jitter seed, fall curves, and landing frames preserves its timing and energy.

rtlDecisions.action: Applied RTL text direction; placed checkboxes and category markers on the right, with trailing progress bars on the left.
rtlDecisions.why: These elements are attached to Persian labels and follow their reading order.

rtlDecisions.what: Fall, camera, 3D perspective, light, and atmosphere
rtlDecisions.action: Kept physical vertical falls, camera transforms, perspective origin, brightness curves, shadows, gradients, and timing unchanged. Kept the outer 3D scene coordinate root LTR; applied RTL only within dashboard regions.
rtlDecisions.why: These are physical/camera effects and are not reading-direction semantics. Root RTL caused the scene to leave frame, so the scene coordinate system stays stable while UI regions explicitly use RTL.

comps.rasterHandling: No raster or video assets are used. All visible interface text is live JSX and was translated; ClickUp remains as a brand mark.

verification.result: ok; one composition; no render errors; full Persian MP4 rendered.
verification.visualNotes: Compared source and localized stills at hover, overlapping landing, transition, and final hold beats. Persian typography is shaped and legible; the final dashboard is fully in frame with right-side navigation. Landing and rise timing match the source.
